name: KallMeKris
profileSummary: Kristina Lee "Kris" Halliwell Collins, better known as Kallmekris, is a Canadian social media personality and actress. Known for her skits that range from thirty seconds to a minute long, Collins began posting on TikTok in April 2020. As of July 2026, she has 50.4 million followers, making her the most-followed TikToker from Canada and the 40th overall. Her YouTube channel, which she began uploading to in 2020, has 13.1 million subscribers as of July 2026. In July 2025, Collins made her feature directorial debut with the found footage horror film, House on Eden.
